facts.text: Through the Augsburg Possible Scholarship, Augsburg University covers the remaining balance of tuition for eligible students on a tuition-free pathway after other aid is applied.

sources.title: Augsburg Possible Scholarship - Augsburg University
sources.quote: Through the Augsburg Possible Scholarship, students begin their educational journey on a tuition-free pathway. This means that, for eligible students, Augsburg will cover the remaining balance of tuition after other merit-based scholarships, grants, and tuition waivers have been applied.
